app_info.subtitle: Santander bus information
app_info.description: TUS Santander helps users find city bus stops and lines, map selected stops, see the stops served by a line, and check the latest published arrival estimates using official Santander Open Data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves current bus-stop records from Santander Open Data and does not modify data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a public municipal dataset without changing any external or publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Find a Santander bus stop by its public stop number.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns stop 15 with its current official name, address, identifiers, and coordinates.

test_cases.description: List current Santander bus lines matching a user query.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current matching lines with their public line numbers and names.

test_cases.description: Retrieve every stop relationship for a valid public line number.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me all stops served by Santander bus line 24C1.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected line and all stop relationships published for it.

test_cases.description: Check the latest published arrivals for a specific stop and line.
test_cases.user_prompt: When is line 1 arriving at Santander bus stop 15?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest matching arrival estimates with destinations, times, distances, and observation timestamps.

test_cases.description: Handle a nonexistent line without fabricating transit information.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the stops for Santander bus line NOT-A-LINE.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a clear tool error explaining that the line does not exist in the official dataset.

test_cases.description: Render selected Santander bus stops on an interactive map.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Santander TUS bus stops near the city centre and show them on a map.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds matching stops, then displays the selected stops as clickable pins on an interactive map.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for bus information outside Santander.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: When does the next EMT Madrid bus arrive?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only supports Santander TUS data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated Santander tourism requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recommend three seafood restaurants in Santander.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because restaurant recommendations are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to purchase transport tickets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy me a TUS bus ticket for tomorrow.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot buy tickets or perform transactions.
